note:
A MATCHED PAIR for /pages/brightening-glow — templates/page.brightening-glow.json, section `content`, blocks `causes` ('What Causes Dull, Uneven Skin?') and `approach` ('The Antioxidant Approach to Brightening'). Both currently wear borrowed photographs: a serum lifestyle shot and the philosophy-page ingredients picture.

SAME SYSTEM AS THE FIRMING PAIR, which went live earlier today and is the reference: square-on front elevation, cut face parallel to the picture plane, no perspective, top surface reduced to a sliver; the block filling the frame; smooth glossy CGI, high-key, soft diffuse light, no hard shadow; no lettering, arrows or callout furniture; square 2048x2048, because the row height in `media-with-text` is set by the master's own aspect and anything else makes the block taller than its five siblings.

THE LAYER STACK IS THE SAME STACK, so the four diagrams on this store read as one anatomy:
  quilted blush-peach surface of soft rounded pads · thin cream film, laminated at the cut ·
  thick band of small rounded pale-pink granules · thin peach plate · pearl-ivory fibre bundles ·
  second peach plate · two rows of cream-blush lobules · clear glass base

BUT THE CAMERA COMES UP, AND THAT IS THE POINT. Firmness lives in the dermis, so those two frames gave the fibre layer and the fat cushion the middle of the picture. Brightness lives at the SURFACE — pigment, dead cells, oxidative stress — so these two zoom to the upper layers: the quilted surface and the granular band fill most of the frame and the fibre layer runs along the bottom edge as a reminder of where we are. Same anatomy, different depth of interest, which is honest to both pages rather than a template reused.

GENERIC SKIN COLOUR AGAIN, DELIBERATELY. The concern-to-colour map binds Brightening & Glow to Glutathione's Champagne DFC08F, and that map is right for the concern tiles and banners — furniture that must be told apart across a grid. It is wrong for anatomy, exactly as Teal was on the firming pair (Malcolm, 2026-08-26: 'please use generic skin colors here'). Champagne is also perilously close to the skin tones themselves, so it would muddy rather than mark. Teal, clinical blue, cobalt, copper, gold, green and purple are negated by name.

THE ONE COLOUR THAT IS ALLOWED, AND WHY. Melanin is soft warm brown, and on a page about uneven tone the pigment has to be visible. That is ANATOMY, not a brand colour, and the briefs say 'soft translucent warm brown pigment granules' while still negating metallic copper, bronze and gold so no supplier turns the pigment into metal.

CLAIMS — THE SHARPEST CONSTRAINT ON THIS PAGE, AND IT DECIDES WHAT THE APPROACH FRAME MAY SHOW. The copy claims that glutathione 'helps defend the skin against the oxidative stress that dulls the complexion', 'supporting a brighter, more even-looking tone over time'. So the approach frame depicts THE ANTIOXIDANT MEETING THE OXIDATIVE STRESS: dark motes fading and dissolving where the actives arrive, and the surface reading clearer and more luminous around those points.

IT MUST NOT DEPICT PIGMENT BEING DESTROYED. No dark spot is erased, bleached, lifted out or faded away; the pigment clusters present in the causes frame are simply not the subject of the approach frame. Skin-lightening imagery would overclaim what the copy says AND contradict the page's own FAQ, which answers 'Is glutathione safe for all skin tones?'. 'No skin whitening, no bleaching, no lightening of skin tone, no pigment being removed, no before and after tone comparison' are all in the negatives, and no face appears in either frame so no tone comparison is even possible.

THE THREE ACTIVES ARE TOLD APART BY FORM, NOT COLOUR — the discipline that worked on the firming approach frame, and here it can be anatomically true:
  GLUTATHIONE  a chain of EXACTLY THREE linked pearl beads. Glutathione is a tripeptide —
               glutamate, cysteine, glycine — so the bead count is accurate rather than decorative,
               and it distinguishes it at a glance from the firming page's four-and-five-bead chains.
  VITAMIN C    a small colourless faceted crystal, because ascorbic acid is crystalline.
  PEPTIDES     short chains of four or five beads, the same device as the rest of the store.
Nothing is tinted. The only bright thing in either frame is the warm white light of the delivery.

WHAT EACH CAUSE LOOKS LIKE, and all four are in every causes slot:
  UNEVEN TONE / MARKS   soft translucent warm-brown pigment granules gathering into irregular
                        clusters and blotches low in the granular band, some drifting up toward the
                        surface so the pads above them are visibly darker in patches
  OXIDATIVE STRESS      fine dark grey angular motes drifting down out of the air and striking the
                        surface, dulling it where they land
  SLOW CELL TURNOVER    the quilted pads at the very top thickened, piled up and overlapping, their
                        edges dry and their surface gone matte and chalky instead of plump and clear
  The four are shown as EVIDENCE, never as characters: no enzyme, no organism, nothing with a face
  or a body. Bacteria, viruses, insects and mites are negated, as they were on the firming causes.

NO BEFORE-AND-AFTER, on the standing rule: contrast is a smooth gradient across one continuous block, never a seam. Slot A runs clean at both ends and dull through the middle, which is the composition Malcolm chose for the firming causes frame; slot B distributes the patchiness instead, offered because 'uneven' is arguably better served by scatter than by one central zone, and he should see both.

CLASS B — no product in frame, no references attached, no product description or brand identity given to any engine. FLUX.2 is in the run; check it at full size for printed numbers, which is a fixed trait.

JUDGE AT 100% AND AGAIN AT RENDER SIZE (660px). Three checks carried from the firming pair: TEXTURE COHERENCE, because horizontal pearl bundles flat-on drift toward noodles and piped icing; HOLLOW TUBE ENDS on any fibre in shot, which disqualified a candidate last round; and now a fourth, specific to this page — PIGMENT MUST NOT READ AS DIRT, a scab, a bruise or a burn. If the brown goes muddy, opaque or scabby rather than soft and translucent, the candidate is out however good the rest of it is.

slots.title: causes A · upper layers close, clean at both ends, dull and pigmented through the middle
slots.prompt:
Soft three-dimensional medical explainer illustration in the style of premium skincare advertising: smooth glossy CGI, luminous and dreamy, high-key on a pale hazy warm cream gradient background. Square format.

A block of skin is shown in cross-section SEEN SQUARE ON FROM THE FRONT. The camera is level and directly in front of it, so the cut face is exactly parallel to the picture plane, its edges horizontal, with no perspective and no convergence. The top surface is not seen as a plane — at most the thinnest sliver of it shows along the upper edge. The block runs from the left edge of the frame to the right edge. THE CAMERA IS CLOSE AND HIGH IN THE BLOCK: the surface and the layers just beneath it fill most of the picture, and only the top of the deeper zone shows along the bottom edge.

THE LAYERS, FROM TOP TO BOTTOM: across the top, a band of surface made of soft rounded raised pads in an irregular tile pattern, blush-peach and slightly felted, large and clearly modelled at this distance; beneath it a thin smooth band of pale cream, finely laminated where it is cut; below that, filling the middle of the picture, a thick band of small rounded pale-pink granules packed densely together like a fine foam of tiny cells; then a thin smooth peach plate; and along the bottom edge, partly cut off by it, the tops of long glossy pale pearl-ivory fibre bundles lying horizontally. The tissue is a soft desaturated peach-cream, warm, pale and matte.

THE BLOCK IS CLEAR AND EVEN AT BOTH ENDS AND DULL THROUGH THE MIDDLE. At the left edge and again at the right edge the skin is at its best: the pads are plump, rounded, evenly sized and softly luminous with a clean sheen, the granular band beneath is uniform and pale, and the whole surface reads one even tone.

ACROSS THE MIDDLE, three things have gone wrong at once and they overlap.

First, LOW IN THE GRANULAR BAND, soft translucent warm-brown pigment granules have gathered into irregular clusters and soft-edged blotches of different sizes, uneven in spacing, some of them drifting upward through the band so that the pads directly above them are visibly darker and patchier than their neighbours. The pigment is soft, translucent and diffuse, never a hard dark mark and never opaque.

Second, AT THE VERY TOP, the quilted pads there are thickened, piled up and overlapping one another, their edges dry and lifting slightly, their surface gone matte and chalky instead of plump and clear, so the light no longer sits on them cleanly.

Third, IN THE AIR ABOVE, fine dark grey angular motes drift downward and strike the dulled surface, a scattered fall of them concentrated over the worst of it and thinning out toward the clear ends.

The change from clear to dull is a slow smooth gradient across one continuous block — no line, no seam, no join, nothing repeated and nothing mirrored, and the dull zone sits a little off centre and is wider on one side than the other. Nothing is arriving to fix it. Soft diffuse light, no hard shadow, shallow depth of field. Glossy, luminous, immaculate.

slots.title: causes B · the whole stack, dullness and pigment scattered in patches across the block
slots.prompt:
Soft three-dimensional medical explainer illustration in the style of premium skincare advertising: smooth glossy CGI, luminous and dreamy, high-key on a pale hazy warm cream gradient background. Square format.

A block of skin is shown in cross-section SEEN SQUARE ON FROM THE FRONT. The camera is level and directly in front of it, so the cut face is exactly parallel to the picture plane, its edges horizontal, with no perspective and no convergence. The top surface is not seen as a plane — at most the thinnest sliver shows along the upper edge. The block runs from the left edge of the frame to the right edge and fills the lower three quarters of the height, with clear hazy air above it.

THE LAYERS SIT DIRECTLY ON ONE ANOTHER, IN CONTACT, one solid continuous slab, from top to bottom: a band of surface made of soft rounded raised pads in an irregular tile pattern, blush-peach and slightly felted; a thin smooth band of pale cream, finely laminated where it is cut; a thick band of small rounded pale-pink granules packed densely like a fine foam of tiny cells; a thin smooth peach plate; a zone of long glossy pale pearl-ivory fibre bundles lying in loose horizontal waves, whole and solid with no cut or open ends; a second thin peach plate; and at the bottom a cushion of large smooth rounded cream-blush lobules. The whole block stands on a thin clear colourless glass plate. The tissue is a soft desaturated peach-cream, warm, pale and matte.

THE DULLNESS IS SCATTERED, NOT GATHERED IN ONE PLACE. Four or five separate patches of trouble sit at irregular intervals along the block, of different sizes and different strengths, with clear even skin between them, so the whole surface reads mottled and uneven rather than divided.

In each patch, three things happen together. Low in the granular band, soft translucent warm-brown pigment granules gather into a loose irregular cluster with soft edges, some drifting upward so the pads above are visibly darker there. At the top, the quilted pads over that patch are thickened, piled up and overlapping, their edges dry and lifting slightly, their surface matte and chalky rather than plump and clear. And in the air above, fine dark grey angular motes drift down and strike those places, more thickly over the worst patches and sparsely elsewhere.

The patches fade into the clear skin around them through smooth gradients with no line, no seam and no hard edge, they are not evenly spaced, and none of them repeats or mirrors another. Nothing is arriving to fix it. Soft diffuse light, no hard shadow, shallow depth of field. Glossy, luminous, immaculate.

slots.title: approach A · pair-match to causes A — three actives arriving, the dark motes dissolving
slots.prompt:
Soft three-dimensional medical explainer illustration in the style of premium skincare advertising: smooth glossy CGI, luminous and dreamy, high-key on a pale hazy warm cream gradient background. Square format.

A block of skin is shown in cross-section SEEN SQUARE ON FROM THE FRONT. The camera is level and directly in front of it, so the cut face is exactly parallel to the picture plane, its edges horizontal, with no perspective and no convergence. The top surface is not seen as a plane — at most the thinnest sliver of it shows along the upper edge. The block runs from the left edge of the frame to the right edge and fills the lower two thirds of the height, leaving clear hazy air above it. THE CAMERA IS CLOSE AND HIGH IN THE BLOCK: the surface and the layers just beneath it fill most of the block, and only the top of the deeper zone shows along the bottom edge.

THE LAYERS, FROM TOP TO BOTTOM: a band of surface made of soft rounded raised pads in an irregular tile pattern, blush-peach and slightly felted, large and clearly modelled; a thin smooth band of pale cream, finely laminated where it is cut; a thick band of small rounded pale-pink granules packed densely like a fine foam of tiny cells; a thin smooth peach plate; and along the bottom edge, partly cut off, the tops of long glossy pale pearl-ivory fibre bundles. The tissue is a soft desaturated peach-cream, warm, pale and matte, and the pads are plump, rounded and softly luminous.

FLOATING IN THE HAZY AIR ABOVE ARE SIX TRANSLUCENT SPHERES OF CLEAR PALE GLASS, of slightly different sizes and at slightly different heights. Three different things are held inside them, and each kind is a different SHAPE, not a different colour.

TWO SPHERES HOLD A CHAIN OF EXACTLY THREE SMALL PEARL-WHITE BEADS, linked in a neat short row — three beads, no more and no fewer. TWO SPHERES HOLD A SINGLE SMALL COLOURLESS FACETED CRYSTAL, clean-edged and glassy, catching a sharp highlight. TWO SPHERES HOLD A LONGER CHAIN OF FOUR OR FIVE SMALL PEARL-WHITE BEADS.

From the underside of four of them a slender shaft of warm white light descends straight down into the surface layers, spreading through the quilted pads and into the granular band beneath but going no deeper. Where each shaft arrives, a soft bright bloom spreads outward through the pads and a small star-shaped glint bursts at the point of contact.

FINE DARK GREY ANGULAR MOTES ARE DRIFTING DOWN OUT OF THE AIR toward the skin, as they always are — but where the light from the spheres reaches them they are BREAKING UP AND FADING, thinning to faint specks and vanishing before they land, so the air close to the surface is clear beneath the lit spheres and still speckled further away. Around each arrival the pads are noticeably clearer, smoother and more luminous, with a clean even sheen, easing back to ordinary further along the block.

Nothing is broken and nothing is being scrubbed away; no mark or patch is being erased from the skin. Soft diffuse light, no hard shadow, shallow depth of field. Glossy, luminous, immaculate.
